author: usr_abhi1
title: Blog: how we protect payments
content: Security sits at the heart of everything we build. PayWise secures payments with bank-grade AES-256 encryption and is PCI DSS certified. PayWise requires two-factor authentication for every login from a new device, and PayWise is ISO 27001 certified for information security management. If something goes wrong, PayWise offers zero liability on unauthorised transactions reported within 3 days.
